title: Mixed Event — Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World — Episode6 As Much As I Want To Help

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World
meta.Episode: Episode6 — As Much As I Want To Help
meta.Event Outline: One day at the archery club, by a strange coincidence, Shizuku senses something hidden beneath Mafuyu's smile. It reminds her of the time when they met for the first time and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Fifty-eight, fifty-nine, sixty.
Okay, that's enough planking...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now that we've warmed up, shall we practice shooting using the hay bales?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Remember how the two of us used to line up like this when we were first years?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I do.
And you were kind enough to help me when you saw that I was having trouble drawing the bowstring.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You were very busy back then, so it must've been hard to learn how to shoot properly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it was. I had so much going on at the time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I really need to thank you. I was able to stay in the archery club because of all the support you gave me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's very kind of you, but I really didn't do anything all that special.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how you practiced with me before the newcomer tournament when we were first years?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The newcomer tournament when we were first years...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
That's right. We did practice together here just before it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
That time, you taught me how to calm myself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And how focusing on just shooting your arrow allows you to clear your mind of unnecessary thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After putting what you said into practice, Asahina, I was able to hit the target for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
Back then, I had so much going on and didn't know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was disappointing everybody at work and couldn't help Airi when she was thinking about changing agencies...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I kept beating myself up about not being able to do anything right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But then, you taught me that calming technique, and I was able to move forward from all that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I learned how to focus on each arrow... I figured out how to put everything into my shot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, all I did was say what I felt...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What saved you that time may have been your work ethic. I was simply there to give you a gentle push.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm standing here today partially because I worked very hard and didn't give up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, I still believe that you played an important role in helping me when I needed it most...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Asahina, thank you for what you did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Just as you helped me that time, Asahina, I'd like to return the favor somehow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When we spoke the other day, you seemed very preoccupied with something...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminded me of how you were just after the newcomer tournament concluded.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You were practicing all by yourself while it was snowing... Which was somewhat concerning...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I came to believe that something must be bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Something that not even your calming technique could help you overcome...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for bringing this up so suddenly, but that's how I feel...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, if there is something bothering you, I'd like for you to talk to me about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You saved me once before, Asahina.
Now it's my turn to help you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When we spoke the other day... I was just beginning to feel the stress of exams since it's nearly that time of year...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And when we were first years... I felt a bit frustrated over finishing in fourth place at the newcomer tournament, so I must've been somewhat on edge.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
So there's nothing for you to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
In that case, I apologize for jumping to conclusions. I didn't mean to be overbearing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I really appreciate how you're trying to look out for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I know...
Since we have the hay bales out, why don't we have ourselves a little contest?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We've never had many opportunities to shoot together like this. So, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Good.
Oh, before we do, I'd like to use the restroom...
